title: Subtle lead accent hairline
description: A quieter alternative to full lead-row emphasis: only a 3px amber accent left-border plus a bolder headsign weight mark row 1 (the imminent/departing row) as the next bus, with no background fill or type-size change. Rendered tile shows the board WITH this emphasis applied.
baseline_ref: .arrival-row:first-child plain row (same treatment as every other row); .arrival-row__headsign font-weight 700

changes.intent: Add a thin accent border on the lead row only, keeping structure otherwise identical to other rows.
Bold the lead row's headsign to reinforce the accent border without resizing or adding a fill.
